tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam 'bras bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga khrigs chags su bkod pa tshogs gnyis rab rgyas

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// "$ (358)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ba nyams su len par 'dod pas/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas khang du byi dor byas shing bla ma gong ma'i phyag len dbu lo la sogs par bzhugs pa'i sku brnyan bris 'bur lugs ma gang rnyed mdo lug dang bstun par bsham/ de'i mdun du stegs bu la ras kyis bkab pa'i steng du me tog sil ma dgram/ de'i sting du mañdza'i khar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gis byugs shing tshom bu lnga pa'i mtha' skor du mtshams 'dzin chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod zlum por bsham/ 'byor na stegs bang rim can la mchod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ bla re gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pas brgyan/ rang gi mdun du mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal mtho gang las mi chung bar dri bzang btab pa'i chu dang 'bru gtsang ma rnams sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dha rmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing (359)rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ ā hūm̐/ sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dha rmā ra ṇi sogs/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// (360)rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnams pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gis rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba ཿswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rnams pa rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po// sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo zhing dwangs la 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu thugs dkar bsnol ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa zhal 'dzum zhing khro ba/ sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog nag po spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba (361)'gying ba dang bcas pa'i sgo nas zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par zhal nang du phyogs pas bzhugs pa/ shar du yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ lhar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa du ma/ nub tu theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos glegs bam gyi rnam pa can dar zab la sogs pas g.yog pa du ma/ byang du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba dang rnal 'byor ma'i cha lugs can du ma/ mtha' skor kun du chos skyong ba'i srung ma nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs par gyur/

de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjer ldan pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo// dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yab/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bla ma/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi skyabs/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// brtse ba chen pos dus thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsol// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs// 'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad// nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang*/ me shel med par me mi 'byung*// de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang*// bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur// des na khyod nyid mnyes pa yis// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur// dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos rnams kun gyi (362)rin chen gter// dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma de la 'dud// khyod ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga// khyod kyi phung po rnam lngar ston// sbyin sogs khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi// sa yi snying po rdo rje 'chang*// nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs// 'jam dbyangs sgrib pa rnam par sel// byams pa kun tu bzang po rnams// mgon po khyod kyi dbang po sogs// gshin rje'i gshed sogs khro bo bcu// dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha// gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mor ston// nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po khyod kyis mkhyen// thams cad spro ba'i phrin las kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprul// gcig tu bsdus pa'i sbyor ba ni// sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje 'chang*// bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib kun spangs// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa// khyod kyi phrin las ngo mtshar rmad// gang gis g.yo med khyod bsten pa// de la de ma thag byin brlab// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs 'tshang rgya// yang na phun tshogs thams cad 'grub// des na rdo rje slob dpon mchog

/dngos po kun gyis de la 'dud// rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na// lus dang longs spyod 'brel ba kun// srog gi bar gyi khyod mnyes bgyi// ji srid rnam par grol ba'i sa// bdag gzhan kun gyis ma thob bar// de srid mchod pa mchog gi sprin// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las/ ches lhag gyur pas khyod mchod do// khyod ni gang la mnyes gyur pa'i// phrin las de nyid sgrub par shog /mi mnyes byed pa rnam spangs te// rnam pa kun tu khyod bsten no// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub slad du// mgon po gang la mnyes gyur na// gal te bla na med pa yi// byang chub thob kyang de dor te// skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi// dge ba 'di yis bdag (363)gzhan kun// khyod mnyes bgyis pa'ang thob par shog /sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas dge ba'i tshul khrims ldan// gsung gi phrin las phun sum tshogs// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus khyab// thugs kyi dgongs pa rab zab pa// chos rnams kun gyi de nyid mkhyen// mkhas pa thams cad dga' mdzad pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la mnga'// sems can thams cad smin mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje// khyod la bsu bas dpal du byed// bsten pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur// bsten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad// bsnyen bkur bgyis pas bde ba 'byung*// de 'dra'i dpal ldan chos kyi rje// bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs// mchod pa thams cad spang nas ni// bla ma mchod pa bya'o zhes// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// de bas dngos po thams cad kyis// bla ma mnyes par byed par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan// ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar// de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du// 'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /mchod pa kun gyis mchod byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu nyan pa dang*// bka' bzhin sgrub par byed par shog

/sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// dngos grub kun gyi rin chen gter// nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba// bla ma kun la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams ye shes rab rdzogs pa// stong pa dang ni snying rje'i bdag /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i dpal// rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin// zag med bde chen sgyu ma'i sku// bde gshegs thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya kun la rab sbyangs nas// brtson pas go 'phang mchog brnyes te// brtse bas (364)gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i// bir wa pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rjes su gdams pa zab mo yis// nyid kyi thugs ni rnam grol zhing*// brtul zhugs spyod pas gzhan don mdzad// nag po pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa'i de nyid don gzigs nas// 'jig rten spyod las rnam grol zhing*// grub pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i// ḍa ma ru pa la phyag 'tshal// zab mo'i lam la rab brtson pas// dngos grub brnyes nas byis pa yi// tshul gyis gnyis med spyod pa mdzad// a wa dhū tī la phyag 'tshal// shes bya kun la rab mkhas shing*// ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pas// gangs can 'dul bar mdzad pa po// ga ya dha ra la phyag 'tshal// dam chos rin chen mdzod 'dzin pas// gdul bya'i re ba rdzogs mdzad pa// skad gnyis smra ba thugs rje can// shākya ye shes la phyag 'tshal// gus pas bla ma nyer bsten nas// rgyud dang man ngag kun 'dzin cing*// mthu stobs chen po dang ldan pa// rje btsun kun rig la phyag 'tshal// mkhyen ldan khyod kyis gzhan don phyir// sgrub la brtson pas ting 'dzin dang*// mngon par shes dang rdzu 'phrul la// mnga' brnyes chos 'bar la phyag 'tshal// 'jam pa'i dbyangs las mngon sum du// khyed kyis chos rnams thugs chung bas// shes bya kun la ma rmongs shing*// mkhas mchog rnams kyi bla mar gyur// thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas// rtag tu gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa// kun dga' snying po la phyag 'tshal// bsod nams dpag med las grub cing*// mkhyen pa'i ye shes rab rgyas pas// 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa// bsod nams rtse mo la phyag 'tshal// chos rnams kun gyi de nyid gzigs// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha (365)rol son// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rje// grags pa rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal// khyod ni man ngag du ma'i mdzod// rab tu brtan pa'i thugs mnga' zhing*// rtag tu gzhan la phan dgongs pa// dpa' chen 'od po la phyag 'tshal// khyod kyis bsod nams ye shes tshogs// bskal pa du mar rab bsgrub pas// bzhed pa'i don rnams yongs rdzogs pa'i// dpal ldan don grub la phyag 'tshal// 'khrul ba mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'// tshul khrims phung pos brgyan pa'i sku// mthong ba tsam gyis rab dad par// mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ca co mi mnga' rnam dag gsung*// tha dad skad kyis mtha' yas pa'i// gdul bya'i dbang po tshim mdzad pa'i// gsung mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam par bzhag cing rtog mi mnga'// 'gro ba'i yid la mnyam par 'jug

/ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi gter// rnam grol thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi shes bya'i dkyil 'khor 'di// ma lus thugs su chud gyur pas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba la// mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs pa kun las rnam grol zhing*// thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas// gzhan don dus las mi 'da' ba'i// brtse chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen brtse brtson pa'i stobs chen gyis// bdud kyi stobs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*// nyon mongs byang chub lam bsgyur ba'i// mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar// rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs kyis// de srid de yi don mdzad pa'i// phrin las dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// kun dga'i dgos 'dod ma lus pa// rin chen rgyal mtshan las byung ba'i// dpal 'byor bzang po'i 'bras stsol ba'i// (366)dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa gzhan don phyir// so so skye bo'i skur ston pa// mtshungs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum po khyod nyid de// khyod nyid dkon mchog gsum yang lags// de bas rnam pa thams cad du// khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ston mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dren pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la khyod kyi skus reg cing*// khyod gsung thos shing 'dzin pa dang*// khyod kyi thugs rjes rjes bzung na// de dag kun la'ang phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rnam dpyod blo gros chen po can// brtul zhugs mchog ldan gsang sngags 'dzin// bsod nams rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal// rmad byung blo gros chen po can// rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nor bu ltar// 'gro la 'dod dgu stsol mdzad pa'i// phrin las bzang po la phyag 'tshal// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma yi// yongs bzung rim gnyis ting 'dzin gyis// nyams rtog mthar phyin brtan pa'i dpal// zhang ston chos rje la phyag 'tshal// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis las// legs 'khrungs don gnyis dpal gyis 'byor// rtse gcig bsgrub la brtson mdzad pa'i// brag phug pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas lugs rtogs pa'i blo gros kyis// shes bya'i de nyid 'byed pa la// rgol ba gzhan gyis mi 'phrogs pa'i// gcig tu ston pa khyod phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog

/tshul khrims thos bsam bsgom par ldan// brtse bas ma nor lam ston pa'i// bka' drin can khyod la phyag 'tshal// ye shes lnga ldan chos kyi rje// rim gnyis rgyal (367)mtshan rtser bzung nas// tshogs gnyis dpal 'byor bzang po yis// 'gro kun skyong mdzad la phyag 'tshal// zab mo'i ting 'dzin rab goms pas// sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes mchog /gang gis brnyes pa chos kyi rje// grub chen bud+dha shrī la 'dud// kun mkhyen gsung gi bdud rtsi yis// dga' ston 'gro la 'gyed mdzad cing*// bzang po'i phrin las gdul bya yi// dpal du gyur pa la phyag 'tshal// dkon mchog dges pa'i lhag bsam can// mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i// dge mtshan dpal yon bzang po can// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// shes bya kun la thogs med cing*// gsung rab rgya mtsho thugs su chud// grags pa'i dpal gyis sa gsum g.yo// 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// rgyud sde kun gyi de nyid gzigs// smin grol dga' ston phyogs bcur 'gyed// mkhyen rab dbang phyug gdul bya yi// 'dren pa dam pa de la 'dud// mtha' yas rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dpal dang ldan// man ngag gtsug gi nor bu gzi 'od kyis// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa gsal mdzad pa// mkhas grub gdengs can dbang po la phyag 'tshal// rgya chen bsod nams lus stobs rab rgyas shing*// bde gshegs gsung rab seng ge'i nga ros yis// log smra'i ri dwags mtha' dag skrag mdzad pa'i// thub bstan gangs ri skyong ba de la 'dud// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma nyer bsten nas// rmad byung yon tan kun gyi gter mnga' zhing*// gsang chen bstan pa spel ba'i phrin las can// 'dren mchog chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas bstan pa legs 'dzin cing*// rin chen dam pa'i chos bzhin spyod// dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbus na brjid// dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal// (368)bla ma rnams dang lhag pa'i lha tshogs la// mchog tu dad pas tshul bzhin mnyes byas nas// rgyud dang man ngag du ma'i mdzod 'dzin pa// ji bzhin smra ba'i seng ge de la 'dud// dkon mchog gsum dngos yongs 'dzin mgon gyis gzung*// khrims ldan thos bsam bsgom pa'i nor gyis phyug

/lhun grub phrin las phyogs brgyar spel mkhas pa'i// blo ldan dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// phun tshogs sa gsum 'dren mchog chos kyi rje// kun khyab dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// mkha' khyab khams gsum sgrol ba'i phrin las can// zab rgyas theg gsum smra ba'i seng ger 'dud// dngos grub kun 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dge legs kun 'byung dkon mchog rin chen dngos// mdo rgyud kun 'byung rje btsun chos kyi rje// byin rlabs kun 'byung dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// rab 'byam shes bya'i nam mkha' yangs pa la// rab gsal mkhyen pa'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas// rab mang blo gsal dpal mo'i dpal yon can// rab mkhas phrin las bzang po de la 'dud// byams pa'i thugs rje'i kun dga'i bstan pa la// bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan legs bzung ste// dpal 'byor bzang po'i skal ldan skyong mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog chos kyi rje la 'dud// kun dga'i legs bshad mkhyen rab 'dab stong rgyas// bsod nams lhun gyis grub pa'i ze'u 'bru can// bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhas pa'i// skal ldan bung ba'i dpal 'byor bzang por 'dud// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs kyi sras// don gnyis lhun grub rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// ma lus 'gro ba sku bzhi'i sar 'dren pa'i// mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// nam mkha' lta bur yangs pa'i (369)mkhyen rab kyis// sangs rgyas bstan pa rab tu gsal mdzad pa// mtha' yas 'gro ba srid las bsgral ba'i phyir// mtshungs med chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// rgya chen shes bya'i chos rnams ma lus pa// ji bzhin rab tu gsal bar mkhyen pa'i thugs// dge legs 'byung gnas thub bstan rgyas mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs// mtha' yas gdul bya'i lha lam rab yangs ngos// smin grol lam bzang tsha zer 'gyed mkhas pa'i// yongs 'dzin nam mkha'i nor bu rin chen mchog

/gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// phun tshogs dge legs phan bde kun gyi gzhi// bsod nams ye shes lhun grub chos kyi rje// lhag bsam ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i rdo rje 'chang*// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag khyod la 'dud// rab 'byams bde gshegs gtsug rgyan bla ma yi// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud tshogs kyis nyer bzung nas// dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan cher 'dzin pa// rin chen byang chub sems ldan khyod la 'dud// legs byas dge ba nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la// dpal ldan phun tshogs nyin mor byed pa'i sku// byams dang snying rje'i gzi 'od 'bum 'phro ba// 'gro rnams skyong mdzad phrin las bzang por 'dud// lhag bsam lhun grub rin chen dbang gi rgyal// dad 'dun rgyal mtshan rtser mchod gsol btab pas// don gnyis dpal 'byor dad ldan 'gro rnams la// stsol mdzad bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen rab 'od kyis ma rig mun sangs shing*// brtse chen thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yis// nus pa phun tshogs thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gnyen// dge legs 'od stong ldan pa de la 'dud// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po sdom gsum gyi// (370)bcud 'dzin phan bde'i 'byung gnas rin po che// dpal ldan byang chub sems kyi rdo rje'i dngos// phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams shes bya'i mkha' dbyings char yangs par// rab gsal mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa// rab mang gdul bya'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa// rab mchog bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byams ldan 'dren pa rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi sras// rmad byung tshul khrims rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// dpal ldan kun dga' bzang po'i rgyal tshab rjer// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rnam dkar tshogs gnyis bsod nams las grub sku// rnam dag gsung rab dpal yon sgrogs pa'i gsung*// rnam grol lam ston brtse ba'i thugs ldan pa// rnam mkhyen bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen rab byams brtse'i nus pa kun gyi gter// rmad byung bsod nams ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun// skal bzang gdul bya'i blo gros rgyas mdzad pa// don gnyis bzang po stsol mdzad zhabs brtan shog

/dge legs bkra shis rgyas pa'i lha lam du// mkhyen brtse lhun grub blo gros dkyil 'khor can// rnam dkar phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa// skal bzang kun dga'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs// rnam dag tshul khrims nam mkha'i khyon yangs par// byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*// lhun grub phrin las 'od zer spro mkhas pa'i// mtshungs med nyin byed dbang por gsol ba 'debs// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thog ma bar dang mthar dge zhing*// rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa// nges par 'byung (371)ba mchog gi lam// dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa// lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas// rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa// tshogs mchog dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal// tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan zhing*// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gnas// bde gshegs bstan pa legs 'dzin pa'i// bshes gnyen kun la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgras// bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas pa// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i// mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi// rab dang yid las byung gyur pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ni// mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis// yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas mchod// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen po brnyes gyur cig

/mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ (372)me tog phal cher me tog bla bre dang*// me tog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// me tog sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi s+t+wa sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ bdug spos phal cher bdug spos bla bre dang*// bdug spos bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// bdug spos sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā// snang gsal phal cher snang gsal bla bre dang*// snang gsal bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// snang gsal sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha ba bo dhi s+t+wa sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tī ts+tsha swā hā// dri mchog phal cher dri mchog bla bre dang*// dri mchog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// dri mchog sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tī ts+tsha swā hā// zhal zas phal cher zhal zas bla bre dang*// zhal zas bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// zhal zas sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra nai wī d+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā// sil snyan phal cher sil snyan bla bre dang*// sil snyan bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// sil snyan sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/
oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi

sogs/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta (373)ya ā warta ya hoḥ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ma ṇi rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐// btsun mo rin chen 'di 'bul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra wa s+t+ri rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐// blon po rin chen 'di 'bul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wa ra ma hā ta rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐// glang po rin chen 'di 'bul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg par rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra hasti rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐// rta mchog rin chen 'di 'bul bas// srid pa'i gzebs las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob ste// sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra a shā rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐// dmag dpon rin chen 'di 'bul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa (374)sa pa ri wā ra khaḍ+ga rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ru pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐// phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra shab+da kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐// phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐// phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ra sa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐// phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra spar+she kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐// oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/

gzhi yongs su dag pa/ dbang chen gser gyis gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab// shar lus 'phags po// lho 'dzam bu gling*/ (375)nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags// rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang*// sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo// dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che// blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ bdug spos ma/ me tog ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sku gnyis kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin (376)gyis rlobs// 'dren pa kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin gyis rlobs// yi dam kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/

mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin gyis rlobs/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin gyis rlobs// dam chos kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin gyis rlobs// dge 'dun kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin gyis rlobs// byang sems kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin gyis rlobs// nyan rang kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin gyis rlobs// chos skyong kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin gyis rlobs// nor lha kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// (377)mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun du byin gyis rlobs// de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma brgya rtsa re dang*// so bdun ma gsol gdab bcas spel mar ci nus phul la// gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi// rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la// lha dang mi'i 'dod yon rmad 'di 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgya legs gnas pa// kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di// chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i khams kun kun la khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid bar// rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas// kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pa'i mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig

/deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir// gus pas khyed la 'bul bar bgyi// kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa'i// yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis// bdag la brtse bar nyer dgongs te// bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ bdag ni thog med dus nas su// las dang nyon mongs (378)dbang gyur pas// lus dang ngag dang yid sgo nas// rang bzhin sdig pa ci bgyis dang*// sdom pa gsum dang 'gal gyur pa'i// nyes pa'i tshogs kun rab 'gyod pas// mchod 'os rnams kyi spyan snga ru// slan chad sdom pa'i sems kyis bshags/ bla ma'i phrin las rmad byung dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom so so skye bo yi// dge ba kun nas rjes yi rang*// 'gro kun smin cing grol bya'i phyir// bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas la// zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// sems can ji srid gnas kyi bar// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs nas// 'gro ba kun gyi don mdzad par// thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bla ma mchog dang sangs rgyas dang*// chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// rtag tu gus pas bdag skyabs mchi// sems can kun gyi don slad du// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// byang chub spyod pa'ang spyad par bgyi// ye shes gsal ba'i spyan ldan pa'i// brtse ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kun// yud tsam bdag la dgongs su gsol// ma rig pa yis ldongs gyur cing*// las kyi chu rlung kyis 'phangs pas// srid pa'i rgya mtshor ltung gyur te// nyon mongs chu srin dbang gyur pas// mi bzad sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// nyam chung blo gros rab dman pa// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// skyob pa mdzad par gsol ba 'debs// bdag cag rnams kyis rab 'bad kyang*// thar pa'i go skabs rnyed par dka'// khyed kyis thugs rje'i phyag brkyangs (379)nas// srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol// mngon par 'du byed kun gyi gzhi// tshul min yid la byed pa'i rgyu// ma rig mun pa 'thibs po che// ye shes zer gyis bsal du gsol// srid pa'i nyes ltung 'byung ba'i gzhi// rtog pa thams cad bskyed byed pa// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'khri shing ni// shes rab ral gris bcad du gsol// kun rmongs kun 'khrugs kun nas dkris// nga rgyal dang ni phrag dog kun// mgon po khyod kyi mthu chen gyis// ye shes chen por bsgyur du gsol// srid pa thog med dus nas su// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// bag chags dri ma gang bsags pa// ye shes chu yis sbyang du gsol// rang gis mngon par spyad pa'i mthus// rang la rang dbang med par ni// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor 'phen byed pa'i// las kyi rlung shugs bzlog tu gsol// las dang nyon mongs kyis sprul pa'i// rkye rga na dang 'chi la sogs// sdug bsngal 'du byed 'gyur ba yi// sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad du gsol// thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba las// sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i// bdud kyi las rnams bzlog tu gsol// 'jig rten pa yis don gnyer pa'i// rnyed dang bskur sti la sogs pa// snying po med pa'i bya ba las// yid ni rab tu bzlog tu gsol// kun gzhi'i lte ba rab brtan cing*// rten 'brel yan lag rtsibs bcu gnyis// sdug bsngal mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i// srid pa'i 'khor lo gzhig tu gsol// gzhan don la skyo bdag chags pas// rang nyid zhi ba don gnyer ba// nyan thos theg pa dman pa'i sems// rnam pa kun (380)tu dgag tu gsol// bdag gi lus dang ngag dang ni// de bzhin yid kyi sgo nas kyang*// sems can kun la rnam kun tu// phan pa rgya chen 'byung bar mdzod// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la// phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba yi// bar du gcod pa thams cad kun// nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bshes gnyen grogs mchog dam chos dang*// gnas bzang ba dang yo byad sogs// rtag tu mthun pa'i rkyen rnams kun// lhun gyis sgrub pa mdzad du gsol// tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing*/

'gro kun rtag tu 'dun pa dang*// ji ltar bsam pa'i don rnams kun// chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// tshe'i 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe// bla ma mchog dang he ru kaḥ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang po dpag yas kyis// mkha' spyod gnas su bkri bar mdzod// mang du smos kyang ci 'tshal te// dbang bcu ldan pa khyed rnams kyis// ji ltar go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// de ltar bdag gis thob par mdzod// bdag gzhan srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// rnam pa kun tu nyams thag pas// mi shes bzhin du gsal ba la// nyes pa snang gang bzod par gsol// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// ma lus gcig tu bsdom byas nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du// rigs gzugs 'byor ldan shes rab dang*// dbang phyug phun sum tshogs gyur cing*// nad med tshe dang ldan gyur cig /sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu spyod pa dang*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rnam pa kun tu mchod par shog /kun dga'i gsung rab rtag nyan cing*// sku yi rgyal mtshan blta ba dang*// de yi dpal 'byor (381)bzang po yis// rtag tu bdag ni skyong bar shog /dad dang brtse dang brtson pa'i mthus// byang chub lam rnams rdzogs byed cing*// sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang*// sems can smin par byed par shog /yid bzhin nor bu chen po ltar// bdag las sems can thams cad kyis// yid la 'dod dgu 'byung 'gyur zhing*// 'gro kun tshim par byed par shog /bdag la brten nas 'gro ba kun// zab mo'i lam la rab zhugs nas// srid dang zhi la mi gnas pa'i// byang chub chen po thob gyur cig /blo gros sgrib gnyis rnam dag pas// shin tu zab pa'i blo gros dang*// rgya che'i blo gros dang ldan pa'i// blo gros chen por bdag gyur cig

/tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang ldan zhing*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs bzung bas// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan brten byas nas// thar pa'i rgyal mtshan slong bar shog /tshogs gnyis dpal rab rdzogs gyur nas// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon 'byung ba'i gzhi// sku gsum dpal 'byor lhun grub ste// srid zhi'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /smon lam bzang po las byung ba'i// phrin las bzang po'i 'gro ba kun// skal pa bzang pos legs bsgrub pa'i// brtul zhugs bzang por bdag gyur cig /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi// rjes su bdag kyang rab zhugs nas// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// thams cad yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar (382)bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi rje// chos kyi rgyal po// chos kyi dbang phyug /chos dam pa'i 'byor pa thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs shing*// 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dpal dam par gyur pa bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi rkyen las gyur pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa dang*// 'byung po'i gnod pa dang*// nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ byur dang skal pa ngan pa dang*// phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang mtshan ma'i rnam par g.yeng ba la sogs pa srid par 'khor bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/

gzhan gyi don la skyo ba dang*/ rang nyid zhi bar 'dun pa la sogs pa mya ngan las 'da' bar gyur pa'i rnam par rtog pa gang lags pa thams cad mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag gi sems las su rung ba dang*/ bag yod pa dang*// dran pa dang shes bzhin yang dag pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnam par dag cing*/ sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*// ltung ba dang nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dad pa dang snying rje dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis zung du chud nas/ lung dang mngon par rtogs pas bsdus pa'i chos kyi snang ba dam pa dang rtog (383)pa dag pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gang gi tshe bdag 'chi bar gyur ba de'i tshe tshe 'di dang 'jig rten 'di la mngon par zhen pa dang bral zhing lus dang sems la zug rngu dang sdug bsngal cung zad cam yang mi 'byung bar dga' ba dang yid gsal ba mchog dang ldan zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas// bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yang dag par mthong zhing*/ de dag gi rnam par 'phrul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas bsus te// bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing*// bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul thams cad las shin tu 'das nas rig pa 'dzin pa dang mkha' la spyod pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang mchog tu skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing srid pa dang zhi ba'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs yang dag par bzung nas/ chos kyis phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong zhing*/

sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas/ dngos po thams cad kyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas te sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bgrod nas/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mchod yul rnams mtha' nas 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu ste rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par bsam/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de'ang rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ rang gi snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi rnam (384)par gyes pa'i dbus su/ pha las thob pa'i dkar cha zla ba dang*/ ma las thob pa'i dmar cha nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i steng du bzhugs te// dus rtag tu byin gyis rlob cing mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen mdzad pa yin snyam du bsams la dad pa dang mos pa rtse gcig pa de nyid la yid cung zad mnyam par bzhag /thun las ldang ba na/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron ma dad pa spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan nas// snying gi chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod bgyid cing*// nges par 'dod pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod de// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog

/skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus nas// dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa thams cad kyang*// las 'bras lhur len gsung rab don la mkhas// tshul khrims (385)dag cing thos la mngon brtson te// thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gcig pu// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /'di'i go don rnams rje sa pan gyi yig cha sogs bla ma gong mas mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams dang rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan sogs su blta bar bya'o// 'di sbyar dge bas bdag gzhan thams cad kyi// dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma mnyes byas nas// gnas skabs mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis rab rgyas te// tshe 'di nyid la grub mtha' snyogs par shog /ces pa lam 'bras bla ma mchod pa'i chog khrigs chags su bkod pa tshogs gnyis rab rgyas zhes bya ba 'di ni bklag bde ba'i phyir rje btsun e waṃ pa'i phyag len ltar dge slong kun dga' chos 'phel gyis bsdebs pa'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis dbang phyug gis bgyis pa'o//

༄༅// bskyed gzhi tshom bu med pa'i skabs kyi bskyed chog ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can sku mdog sngon po// zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs kyis na bzas mdzes pa/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing*// gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang (386)ldan pa/ thugs shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa/ 'od zer bye ba 'gyed pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing*/ bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa// de'i mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ /mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang*/ thugs rjer ldan pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal ba sogs man chad dkyus bzhin no// dge'o//
